title: Endpoint performance radar: interactive latency cohorts by model, route, and IO-mode
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an interactive 'performance radar' dashboard that lets SREs and product engineers explore latency cohorts (p50/p95/p99) across model, model_variant, route, and IO-mode (streaming vs non-streaming). The radar will show radial/cohort views for request shapes (sequence length bucket, token count, concurrency) and let teams drill into trace links, histogram overlays, and delta comparisons vs baseline. This ticket covers the dashboard UI, the telemetry queries/rollups, required tracing hooks, and alerting thresholds for significant distribution shifts.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive dashboard page deploys to Console with a Performance Radar panel that can filter by model, route, region, and IO-mode
P50/P95/P99 shown for each cohort, computed from aggregated histograms with stable memory characteristics
Streaming vs non-streaming toggle overlays both time-series and percentile histograms
Drill-through links open sampled traces for the selected cohort and time window
Alert rule prototype created: when p95 for any model-route-io_mode increases >20% vs baseline for 30m
Documentation (Confluence) and runbook for interpreting the radar added
telemetry_queries: ClickHouse: aggregate hdr_histogram by (model_name, route_name, io_mode, seq_len_bucket) to compute p50/p95/p99 over sliding 5m windows
PromQL: rate(error_count_total[5m]) / rate(request_count_total[5m]) per model_route to derive error ratios
Tracing: trace_id tagging for model_route and io_mode; sampled traces exported to Tempo and linked from dashboard
Log pipeline: enrich access logs with model_variant, container_host, kernel_type via Vector pipeline and send to S3 for long-term investigation
dashboard_panels: Radar view: radial rings are percentile buckets; slices are cohorts by seq_len_bucket + concurrency
Heatmap: p95 across route x model matrix with streaming/non-streaming split
Time series: p50/p95/p99 overlays for selected cohort with baseline comparison
Histogram overlay: streaming vs non-streaming response-time histogram for the selected time window
Trace samples panel: top slow traces with links to Tempo/Jaeger and flamegraph snippets
Attribution waterfall: breakdown of median latency by component (gateway, auth, routing, runtime queuing, kernel execution, network)
Cohort picker: request-shape buckets (seq_len, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, concurrency)
rollout_plan: Week 1: spike and prototype ClickHouse HDR histogram rollups and simple UI mockup (POC) - ENG spike branch
Week 2: implement telemetry ingestion changes (Vector/Vector pipeline config PR) and tracing hook update to tag model_route/io_mode
Week 3: dashboard implementation in Console; backend query endpoints and caching; internal dogfooding
Week 4: iterate on UX based on SRE feedback; add alerting rules and publish runbook; release to canary orgs
Post-release: monitor false positives on alerts for 2 weeks and tune cohort buckets/thresholds
comments: 2026-03-02 - Maya Chen: Spike complete. Prototype computes p95 using ClickHouse HDR_histogram aggregate. Observed memory blow-up when naively storing raw percentiles; HDR reduces cardinality. See Confluence: /observability/latency-radar/spike-notes

2026-03-04 - Carlos Ortega: Telemetry change PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/128). Adds model_route and io_mode tags to access metrics and traces. Needs review from runtime team for tag attachment location.

2026-03-06 - Ava Patel: Runtime change approved; we will attach io_mode at the earliest routing layer to capture streaming vs non-streaming before batching. Note: kernel_type may not always be available at routing time; pass as enrichment later in Vector pipeline.

2026-03-08 - Priya Sharma: Initial Console panel mockups uploaded to Figma and linked in Confluence. UX note: avoid showing more than 8 cohorts by default; use adaptive sampling for trace links to keep frontend responsive.

2026-03-10 - Liam O'Neill: Alerting proposal: p95 increase >20% vs 7d rolling baseline for 30m. Concern: vertical spike due to cold cache will create noise. Suggest adding minimum request volume filter and anomaly suppression window.

2026-03-12 - Carlos Ortega: Switched histogram aggregation from naive quantile sketches to HDR_histogram buckets in ClickHouse. Implemented server-side caching for computed cohorts; initial load latency in Console reduced by ~40% in local tests.
